Absolutely dreadful experience. My order for an alpha bed and mattress, placed on August 4th, 2023, turned into an ongoing nightmare. After much anticipation, they finally took action on the 10th of August, only to replace the erroneous bed with yet another damaged and incorrect model. Throughout this entire ordeal, the uncomfortable mattress lingers in my possession, and their indifference toward facilitating a return is staggering.

Adding insult to injury, I find an email in my inbox on August 11th, 2023, declaring my issue resolved. Each time I've mustered the patience to contact their customer service, the response has been depressingly uniform: "We are escalating your issue." Regrettably, the direction or purpose of this supposed escalation remains an enigma to me.

I must emphasize that my prior experience with Rentmojo had been devoid of any issues, making the stark contrast with this current company all the more disappointing. It is my candid opinion that this company's performance falls far below par.

UPDATE on 16th August 2023 - Still stuck with the mattress and the wrong bed. Absolutely no communication from their team.

However, the moment the order was placed, everything changed.
From the very next day, he completely stopped answering my calls and responding to messages. There was absolutely no follow-up, no support, and no accountability. It felt like once the sale was secured, customer service no longer mattered.
